title: paperpin result
description: What paperpin.save() / `paperpin ground -o` writes, and what any consumer in any language can rely on. `paperpin.schema` is the version of THIS shape; it moves only when the payload changes, unlike `paperpin.version`.

version.description: the paperpin library release that produced this file

schema.description: version of this payload's shape — branch on this, not on `version`

coordinate_space.description: human-readable statement of what every bbox is relative to

source.description: the document this result was produced from, as it was passed in

fields.description: every value that was asserted, keyed by field name. Table rows are flattened to `name[i].column`.

summary.description: field count per status; a status absent from the run is absent here

meta.description: run metadata. Keys vary by run — model runs add `extract_seconds`, `token_usage` and `pages_truncated`; OCR runs add `ocr`. Consumers must tolerate keys they do not know.

status.description: verified: located, every check agreed. low_confidence: located with doubt. ambiguous: several equally plausible locations, all in `candidates`. not_found: asserted but matches nothing on the page — the hallucination flag. not_present: the model itself said the field is not on the document.

bbox.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1) normalized 0..1, origin top-left, on the upright original page. Multiply by the page raster's pixel size to draw it.

width.description: original-space width: pixels for images, points for PDF pages

route.description: how this page's geometry was obtained

dpi.description: render resolution, present only when a raster was actually produced

exact.description: false for a fuzzy or partial match

fused.description: evidence glued from separate printed runs

value.description: the asserted value, exactly as it came in — any JSON type

page.description: 0-based; null when the field was not located

evidence.description: the exact document text that matched

method.description: how the matched text was located

proof.description: set when a verification check positively proved the value

anchor.description: label text found near the value

quote.description: source quote the model supplied, if any

repaired_value.description: checksum-driven repair of an OCR-confusable value

candidates.description: for ambiguous: every tied location. Otherwise the location that won, or empty.
